justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/type/Type.java` (371 lines) and related subtypes `ReferenceType.java`, `ArrayType.java`, `PrimitiveType.java`, `ClassOrInterfaceType.java`, and `TypeParameter.java`. `Type` has one real field (`annotations`) and most of its methods are generated one-line defaults for AST plumbing and type-dispatch (`is/as/to/if` for the known type variants), plus `clone`, `getMetaModel`, `remove`, `replace`, and abstract hooks like `asString()`/`resolve()`. The concrete subtype-specific responsibilities are already split into the subclasses, so this looks like a cohesive base abstraction rather than a class that should be decomposed further.
